args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.002.
